title: Pictures are made of pixels
heading: Zoom in: a picture is a grid of colours.
description: A pixel is one tiny colour sample in a digital picture. When we magnify the picture, we can show each pixel as a whole square. The grid lines below are guides to help us see the difference.

explanation.title: A point on graph paper
explanation.text: A geometric point has a position but no width or height. We draw a small marker where two lines cross to show where it is.

explanation.title: A pixel in a picture
explanation.code: A colour for the whole cell
explanation.text: In this enlarged picture, one pixel fills one square. It sits between the grid lines, rather than at their intersection. Many coloured pixels make an image.
